name: St. Michael's Church
address: Hurlbut and Linden Streets, south-east corner

status.note: The walls stood; the steeple burned and the bells fell (Andreas vol. 2, p. 405).
status.today: Its later history is not researched here

summary: The German Catholic parish had just finished this huge brick church, with a tower and a chime of bells. The fire burned its roof and steeple, and the bells crashed down. But the walls were built so well that they stood.

notable.text: The steeple was low, but it held a whole chime of bells.
The walls were so well built that they stood through the fire.
A tower on the east corner, a tall gable with a round window, and tall arched windows down the side.
notable.note: Read off the engraving of the ruins (Andreas vol. 2, p. 405).

story.text: The parish outgrows its old church and builds this one.
The fire burns the roof and steeple; the bells fall.
